title: Solar activity cycle row
description: One numbered solar activity (Schwabe) cycle, minimum-to-minimum. Required fields are the ones every cycle row shares (number, start_year, source_doi, source_published_date, entered_locally_at). length_years is null for the ongoing cycle.

number.description: Conventional solar-cycle number (cycle 1 began in 1755; the SILSO-tracked numbering). Recent cycles: 23, 24, 25.

start_year.description: Cycle-minimum epoch as a decimal year (e.g., 2008.96 for the deep cycle 23/24 minimum).

length_years.description: Cycle length in years (minimum-to-minimum). Null for the ongoing cycle whose next minimum has not yet occurred. The Schwabe mean is ~11 yr; individual cycles range ~9-14 yr.

source_key.description: Short citation key into the module SOURCES dict (e.g., 'hathaway_2015', 'clette_2014'). Redundant with source_doi; retained for cross-linking the per-row source to the module's full citation string.

source_doi.description: DOI of the peer-reviewed paper / review authorising this row's numerical values. Required by the literature_curated adapter for per-row attestation.

source_published_date.description: ISO 8601 date the cited paper was published. 'YYYY', 'YYYY-MM', or 'YYYY-MM-DD'. Curator-authored from the cited DOI's metadata; aligns with Dublin Core dcterms:issued. Distinct from attestation.retrieved_at.

entered_locally_at.description: ISO 8601 date this row was first added or last meaningfully amended. Curator-authored; aligns with Dublin Core dcterms:dateAccessioned.

source_version.description: Optional version/edition tag (e.g., the SILSO sunspot-number recalibration version); null where the DOI fully resolves the version.

notes.description: Per-row free-text notes — cycle amplitude / minimum-depth context, cross-references to the Hale polarity closure or the butterfly drift.
